correctness.rationale: Fx=-z^3 eliminates affine singularities, and Fz at the unique infinity point is nonzero. Any line y=t z meets infinity with multiplicity one; only x=a y+b z can be another bitangent. Squaring Q=y^2+u yz+v z^2 in F3 and comparing all coefficients yields A(a)=a^9-d a^3+a+e+dc-c^3 and B(a,b)=b^3-b-f+[(a^3-c)^2-d]^2. Independent sparse-polynomial F3 verification reproduced the unconditional identity, while A_a=1, B_b=-1 give etale covers of degrees 9 and 3. Q=(y-u z)^2-dz^2 supplies contact roots r^2=d; unique tangent line at a smooth point prevents double-counting between bitangents. For d!=0 54 finite points plus infinity; for d=0 each of 28 lines is hyperflex. No assertion on Frobenius orbit counts.
